solution:
The correct answer is __**1 - b, 2 - c, 3 - a, 4 - d**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Simon Commission visits India:** This event took place in the year **1928**.
 
• **Cripps Mission visits India:** This event occurred in the year **1942**.
 
• **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre:** This tragic event happened in the year **1919**.
 
• **Chauri Chaura incident:** This incident took place in the year **1922**.
 
• Therefore, the correct matching is:

 1 - b (1928)

 2 - c (1942)

 3 - a (1919)

 4 - d (1922).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simon Commission:** A group of British Members of Parliament that came to India to study constitutional reform.
 
• **Cripps Mission:** A British initiative in World War II to secure Indian cooperation and support for the war effort.
 
• **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre:** A massacre in which British troops fired on a large crowd of unarmed Indians in Amritsar, Punjab.
 
• **Chauri Chaura incident:** A violent protest by Indian villagers against police, which led to the suspension of the non-cooperation movement by Mahatma Gandhi.
